verdict.rationale: pnpm can pin/install a per-project Node.js version (packageManager field auto-switch, pnpm runtime set) which covers automatic tool-version activation, but there is no evidence of automatic environment-variable activation on directory entry (no dotenv/direnv-like feature documented). missing for 10: documented automatic env-var loading per project, evidence of automatic activation without manual command invocation (e.g. no shell hook comparable to direnv), independent confirmation of packageManager auto-switch working in practice.
